title: Data normalization and irregularity detection system

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: ingesting records from heterogeneous files, databases, ledgers, or provider systems
detecting source formats and translating data into a common or canonical representation
mapping codes, abbreviations, descriptions, and source-specific terminology into analyst-readable fields
using statistics and visualizations to identify unusual patterns or deviations
interactive filtering and drill-down from aggregate anomalies to underlying records
learning or adapting format mappings from previously seen data
using annotation and reference mappings to enrich normalized records

scope_model.analysis_loop: ingest authorized records -> detect source format -> normalize to canonical schema -> resolve codes/descriptions -> compute baselines and distributions -> surface deviations -> allow analyst filtering/drill-down -> record review outcome and provenance
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: preserve raw source values alongside normalized values
version schema mappings and transformation logic
separate format detection from business-rule anomaly detection
show analysts why a record was flagged and which baseline or rule contributed
use anomalies as review signals rather than automatic allegations
allow drill-down from aggregate statistics to source evidence under access controls
monitor mapping drift and unknown-field rates
keep sensitive identity attributes minimized and access-controlled

independent_claim_themes: receiving records associated with persons/providers and determining record format
mapping source fields into canonical fields
calculating converted values based on data type or conversion factors
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.
